title: M5: apricity import --markers brings the DAW's corrected warp markers back
description:
## Purpose
`apricity import --markers <file.asd|file.alc>` brings warp markers corrected in the DAW back into Apricity as warp markers of yours (M4), so the corrections feed compile, markup and later exports instead of fighting them. `apricity import --reset-markers <audio>` goes back to the analysis grid.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Apricity
  participant F as sample folder
  participant D as the DAW
  A->>F: export --sidecars (M2): x.wav.asd
  D->>F: drag in, move markers, Save in clip view
  A->>F: import --markers x.wav.asd
  Note over A: validate, re-number beats, diff against the current grid
  A->>A: store as warp markers of yours (manifest or library Marker records)
  A->>A: compile: the timeline follows the DAW's markers
```

## Scope
File mode (manifest `annotations`) and library mode (`--library`, Marker records, synced like any record); `.asd` (versions M1 reads) and `.alc`; `--sample` to name the audio; `--beat-offset`; `--dry-run`; a report of what moved; `--reset-markers`.

## Out of scope
Importing clips (regions) from `.alc` as saved clips; reading a whole set (`.als`); editing markers in the web app.

## Definition of Done
1. `features/daw/import_markers.feature` (CLI runner) green; a `features/data/domain/` scenario for the replace-warp-markers operation.
2. Rust (`apricity-daw::import`, `apricity-cli`, `apricity-data::domain`); Python parity only through M4's validator (the server's annotation check).
3. No new schema change beyond M4.
4. CLI flags, `--help`, report, every error with file and line/byte/marker index.
5. M1 fixtures, including `steady-120-edited.wav.asd` from the DAW.
7. `docs/tools.md` import section; `docs/concepts.md` round-trip walkthrough; README.
8. Web need filed.
9. `safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw -p apricity-cli -p apricity-data`; the manual end-to-end round trip with listening.
11. `feat(<task id>)`; not breaking.

## Initiative Definition of Done this closes
"Importing an edited `.asd` changes the compiled timeline the way the markers say" and, with M2, "a sample from the library opens in the DAW on the grid with no re-warping".

## Dependencies
Blocked by M1 (readers) and M4 (storage and compile of your markers). M2 only for the manual round trip.
